system.description:
Battle Amp

You embody the power of the Apex of the sea.

Ocean Bond. When Water Walking or swimming, double your movement speed.

Cold Blooded. Creatures with the following conditions, increase the damage they take from you by +4 (Bleed, Concussed, Dazed, Demoralized, Grappled, Restrained or Shaken)

Ravenous Aura. [Unarmed Damage] and [Weapon Damage] you deal can trigger your Ravenous Chakra clan feature, as if it were a C-Rank Jutsu. You cannot gain temporary chakra using Ravenous Chakra this way.

Limitless Blue. Jutsu you cast with the Water Release keyword gain their additional effects as if near a sufficient source of Water.

Efficient Recovery. Once per turn, increase Temporary Hit points gained from allied or self-sourced effects by +6.
system.summary: Double speed swimming or water walking. +4 damage to creatures with listed conditions; unarmed and weapon hits trigger Ravenous Chakra.

rules.text: Entering again before a long rest: 1 rank of exhaustion (once per rest free).
Efficient Recovery: +6 temp HP once per turn on temp HP you gain.
